topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per AS 23 Accounting for Investment in Associates In Consolidated Financial Statements, which of the following situations indicate significant influence of investor over an associate?

I. Representation on the board of directors or governing body of the investee
II. Participation in policy making processes
III. Material transaction between the investors and the investee
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per section 77A of the Companies Act, no offer of buy-back shall be made within a period of _______ from the date  preceding the offer of buy-back, if any.
e: Correct answer: 365 days (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The auditors shall express their opinion specifically on which of the following aspects as required by the IRDAI regulations and the provisions of the Sec.143 of the Companies Act, 2013 ?

I. Whether the profit and loss account and balance sheet gives a true and fair view for the financial year
II. Whether the accounting policies selected by the insurer are appropriate
III. Whether investments have been valued in accordance with the provisions of the Act
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In general insurance business, premium income is accounted for on "Net Premium Earned" basis, and not on "Gross Premium Collected" basis. This as per which accounting concept?
e: Correct answer: Accounting Period concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Major Ltd. has signed a reinsurance contract with a Minor Ltd. Which of the following could be a good reason behind this decision?
o: Elimination of competition between Major Ltd. and
Improved working capital position of the companies
Ability to dictate terms to the IRDA
Ability to dictate terms to the Finance ministry
e: Correct answer: Improved working capital position of the companies (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: On 31 December 2009, Hummer Ltd purchased goods on credit from one of its supplier named Max outsource Pvt. Ltd with a list price of Rs. 25,200. The Max outsource gave Hummer Ltd a trade discount of 15% on the spot because of bulk quantity purchase at a time. The credit period given was 90 days. Max outsource also offered a cash discount of 10% for early payment within 15 days. What is the amount that Hummer Ltd will debit to their purchases account?
e: Correct answer: Rs.21,420 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Given below are the balance of ledger accounts of Keshav Trading Private Limited.

I. Purchase of goods
II. Sales of goods
III. Proprietor's capital
IV. Salaries
V. Carriage outwards

Which of the following balances shall be shown on the debit side of trial balance?
e: Correct answer: I, IV and V (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which section of the Companies Act, 2013 provides for the preparation and attachment of Board's Report along with the financial statements?
e: Correct answer: Section 134 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Finpro insurance company entered into two surplus treaty contracts with reinsurers:

I. The first surplus treaty consisted 10 lines with a maximum liability of Rs. 25 lakhs
II. The second surplus treaty consists of 20 lines with a maximum liability of Rs. 45 lakhs If the gross sum insured is Rs. 70 lakhs and the retention applicable is Rs. 2 lakhs, calculate the facultative arrangements to be made which are not covered through treaty insurance.
e: Correct answer: Rs. 8 lakhs (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: What does a favourable balance in the Pass book imply?
e: Correct answer: Debit  Balance of Cash Book (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: XYZ ltd. has framed an investment policy. The Board of XYZ ltd. shall review the investment policy and its implementation on a ________.
o: A half yearly basis or at such short intervals as
e: Correct answer: A half yearly basis or at such short intervals as (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: _______________ maintains property or wealth, and is incurred to acquire or maintain current / trading assets. Further, it also includes all expenditure that provides current benefits i.e. benefits which can be potentially realised within the accounting period.<
e: Correct answer: Revenue expenditure (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
When a Company forfeits the shares of a shareholder issued at premium, the premium amount received on those shares shall be transferred to which of the following accounts?

I. Securities Premium Account
II. Capital Reserve Account
III. Share Capital Account
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: How would you explain the term consistency when discussing financial accounting information?
o: Information is measured similarly across the indus
Information that is measured and reported in a similar fashion across points in time
e: Correct answer: Information that is measured and reported in a similar fashion across points in time (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ____________ is a contract entered by a company with certain parties (called underwriters), whereby the underwriters undertake that in case of the whole or an agreed portion of the shares or debentures are not subscribed by the public, then they will themselves take up the shares or debentures in consideration of a commission.
e: Correct answer: Underwriting (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The amount of depreciation charged on a machinery will be debited to:-
e: Correct answer: Depreciation A/c (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A trader withdraws money from business bank account for personal expenses. Which entries record this in his books?
o: DR Bank Account CR Capital Account
DR Capital Account CR Bank Account
DR Drawings Account CR Bank Account
DR Bank Account CR Drawings Account
DR Capital Account CR Drawings Account
e: Correct answer: DR Drawings Account CR Bank Account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Deferred Tax Liability arises when:-

I. Taxable income is less than accounting income
II. Taxable income is more than accounting income
III. Taxable income is equal to the accounting income
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Big Insurers has had its accounts audited by its auditor. The motor car has been depreciated over a period of ten years. The auditors made correct calculation but the useful life of the motor car has not been estimated correctly. Therefore, the financial statements of the company are said to be ____________.
e: Correct answer: True but not fair (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: AXL Ltd purchased an office space for Rs. 75 lakhs in Jan 2015. An amount of Rs. 5 lakhs was spent. for further development and Rs. 5 lakhs for registration charges in the same year. At the year end the market value of the said building was found to be Rs. 95 lakhs. What is the value of the office to be recorded in the books as per the historical cost concept?
e: Correct answer: Rs. 85 lakhs (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following transaction are classified under operating activities under a cash flow statement under Direct Method?
e: Correct answer: Cash received from customers (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
ABC General Insurance Co Ltd gives the following details for 2009-10:-

(i) Earned Premium is Rs. 900 crore
(ii) Incurred Claim Net Rs. 600crore
(iii) Commission Net Rs. 100 crore
(iv) Operating Expenses Rs.190 crore

Compute Underwriting Results
e: Correct answer: Rs.10 crores (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Who is responsible for preparation and presentation of financial statements of a general insurance company?
e: Correct answer: Management (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Debiting the petty cash book with the exact amount spent in the previous period is an example of ____________.
e: Correct answer: Imprest System (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of following items do not require separate disclosure in the balance sheet?
e: Correct answer: Premiums received (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Management Expenses or Operating Expenses related to insurance business are apportioned to Revenue Account (Fire, Marine and Miscellaneous departments) on the basis of Gross Direct Premium plus Reinsurance Accepted. What is the weightage given to Fire department?
e: Correct answer: 100% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: This concept states that an entity will continue to carry on its business activities for an indefinite period of time.  Identify this concept.
e: Correct answer: Going concern concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Axa ltd is a Marine Insurance Company. Identify the percentage of the net premium which the Company is required to reserve for the unexpired risk.
e: Correct answer: 100% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: If you want to locate a similarity between facultative and treaty reinsurance, what would it be:-
o: Both are optional so far as ceding of insurance is
Both are optional so far as accepting of insurance
Both may be transacted on proportional basis
Both may be transacted on non- proportional basis
Both may be transacted on proportional as well as non- proportional basis
e: Correct answer: Both may be transacted on proportional as well as non- proportional basis (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: When the balance as per pass book is the starting point, interest Charged by the bank is ______.
e: Correct answer: Subtracted from bank reconciliation (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
In the insurance business, which among the following can be termed as subsidiary books of accounts?

I. General ledger for premium account
II. Premium register
III. Claim payment register
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: If there is a loss of Rs. 1,00,000 under a 40 percent quota share reinsurance treaty, the reinsurer will bear __________.
e: Correct answer: Rs.40,000 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per the provisions of Companies Act, 2013, in case Where a company is not in a position to redeem any preference shares or to pay dividend, what are the options available to the company?

I. Cancel the preference shares which cannot be redeemed
II. Issue further redeemable preference shares equal to the amount due, including the dividend thereon
III. Redeem the preference shares by issue of debentures
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The Auditing Assurance Standards applicable in India are issued by which of the following institutions?
o: Institute of the Chartered Accountants of India
Institute of Company Secretaries of India
American Institute of Certified Public Accountants
e: Correct answer: Institute of the Chartered Accountants of India (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements are correct with regards to a trial balance?

I. A trial balance will always balance
II. Trial balance reveals the financial position of business
III. A trial balance reveals whether double entry principles have been complied with
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per the accounting policies adopted in General Insurance companies, other assets and liabilities in foreign currencies are converted at which of the following exchange rates?
o: Average of buying and selling rates of exchange of each quarter in which they are accounted for
Buying rate of exchange of each quarter in which t
Selling rate of exchange of each quarter in which
Buying rate of exchange at the end of accounting p
Selling rate of exchange the end of accounting per
e: Correct answer: Average of buying and selling rates of exchange of each quarter in which they are accounted for (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: This reserve is created to meet the claims which arise when the policies mature in the subsequent years. Identify this reserve.
o: Reserve for bad and doubtful debts
e: Correct answer: Technical reserve (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC Ltd has received some shares through issue of bonus shares, in the books of ABC ltd., the nominal value of such shares will have to be  ______________.
o: Debited to the Cost column of investment account
Debited to the Income column of investment account
Debited to the Nominal value column of investment
Credited to the Nominal value column of investment
Credited to the Income column of investment accoun
e: Correct answer: Debited to the Nominal value column of investment (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Devise a procedure that helps the management in achieving the maximum organisational and operational effectiveness:-
e: Correct answer: Internal Audit (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which among the following is / are objective/s of the financial statements?

I. To provide information about financial position of entity
II. To provide information about financial performance of entity
III. To provide information about cash flow of entity
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
A Ltd. has issued redeemable preference shares. The management of the company wants to know the options available to the company to redeem the preference shares. Suggest them suitable options.

I. By fresh issue of equity shares
II. Out of distributable profits being retained and transferred to Capital Redemption Reserve Account
III. By combination of both the methods
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Deewali advance given to an employee is:
e: Correct answer: Not an expenditure (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: An insurance company spent Rs.10 crore for purchasing an office space at a prime location in Mumbai in 2010-11. The value of the office space shall be charged over a period of 20 years in the form of depreciation. This is done as per which accounting concept?
e: Correct answer: Going concern concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following are characteristics of Debentures?

I. Debenture is a document evidencing borrowings by a company
II. It is a fixed interest-bearing security where interest is payable at a predetermined fixed rate on specific dates
III. It is issued with or without charge created on assets of the company as security
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Clause 49 of the Listing Agreement requires that details about annual general meeting are included in the report of corporate governance. Details of how many AGM needs to be mentioned?
e: Correct answer: Three (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Explain with regards to accounting in a co-insurance arrangement, how is the co-insurer's share in premium income accounted for?
o: Recorded as payables to other co-insurer (liability) in balance sheet
Recorded as a claim expense in Revenue account
Recorded as due from other co-insurers (asset) in
Not recorded in the books as it does not relate to
e: Correct answer: Recorded as payables to other co-insurer (liability) in balance sheet (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which among the following is the first step in the accounting cycle?
e: Correct answer: Identifying (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following are not true as per the provisions of Companies Act, 2013 for payment of underwriting commission?

I. The payment of the underwriting commission is to be authorized by the Articles of Association of the company
II. In case of shares, the amount of commission paid or agreed to be paid shall not exceed 5% of the issue price in case of debentures
III. The amount of commission paid or agreed to be paid should not exceed 1.5% of the issue price of equity shares
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Sanjay bought a machine for Rs.12,750. He paid for the new machine by taking out a loan of Rs.8,000 and trading inhis old machine. The old machine originally cost Rs.8,500 and had been depreciated by Rs.4,148 at the time of the trade in. What is the gain on disposal of the old machine?
e: Correct answer: Rs.398 (from the IC46 question bank).
